# Concordia University

> Concordia University is a comprehensive research institution in Montreal offering undergraduate and graduate programs across multiple faculties with extensive student support services, international opportunities, and campus resources.

Concordia University serves students from around the world with programs through the John Molson School of Business, Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science, Faculty of Arts and Science, and Faculty of Fine Arts. The university provides integrated student services through the Student Hub, Birks Student Service Centre, and specialized offices for international students, graduate studies, and academic support.

## Admissions & Academic Programs

- [Concordia University Homepage](https://www.concordia.ca): Concordia University homepage with faculties, programs, admissions and campus life
- [Admissions](https://www.concordia.ca/admissions.html): Admissions information for undergraduate, graduate and international students
- [Academic Calendar & Dates](https://www.concordia.ca/events/academic-dates.html): Academic calendar with term dates, deadlines and important events

## Student Support & Services

- [Birks Student Service Centre](https://www.concordia.ca/students/birks.html): Birks Student Service Centre with student support and contact information
- [International Students Office](https://www.concordia.ca/students/international.html): International student services including immigration, visas and settlement
- [Study Help & Tutoring](https://www.concordia.ca/students/services/study-help-tutoring.html): Tutoring, writing assistance and academic support services
- [Parents, Families and Guardians](https://www.concordia.ca/parents.html): Resources and guides for parents of Concordia students
- [Campus Safety and Prevention Services](https://www.concordia.ca/campus-life/security.html): Campus safety, security services and emergency preparedness resources

## Student Orientation & Onboarding

- [Welcome Guide for Undergraduate Students](https://www.concordia.ca/students/undergraduate/welcome.html): Onboarding guide and resources for new undergraduate students
- [New Graduate Students](https://www.concordia.ca/gradstudies/students/new.html): Orientation and onboarding guide for new graduate students

## Academic Resources & Technology

- [Concordia University Library](https://library.concordia.ca): Library homepage with Sofia discovery tool, databases and research resources
- [IT Services](https://www.concordia.ca/it.html): IT services including support, software tools and service status
- [Concordia Wireless Network](https://www.concordia.ca/it/services/concordia-wireless-network.html): Wireless network configuration and device setup guide for Concordia

## Career Development & Opportunities

- [Hire a Student - Experiential Learning](https://www.concordia.ca/academics/experiential-learning/partners/hire-a-student.html): Employer hiring platform for internships, co-ops and student recruitment
- [Concordia Student Exchange Program](https://www.concordia.ca/students/exchanges/csep.html): Concordia Student Exchange Program for study abroad opportunities
